resources.string: A zip file of everything COMMAND keeps, as files you can read: one for each kind of record, and your history as a spreadsheet. It holds the titles of your missions and what you did with each alarm, and it goes only where you save it.
Save a copy of my data
That did not save, and nothing was changed. Try again, or choose another place.

Deletes your missions, your schedule, your history and your settings from this phone, takes back every alarm and notice, and closes COMMAND. It cannot be undone. A copy you saved stays where you saved it.
Erasing did not finish. Try again.
This deletes everything COMMAND keeps on this phone, and it cannot be undone. Alarms that are set are taken back and COMMAND closes. Copies you saved stay where you saved them.
Everything was deleted. COMMAND is closing.
